Headquarters: Remote
 
URL: https://cribl.io/

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.

• Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.

• Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.

• Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.

• Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.

• Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.

• Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.

• Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.

• Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.

• Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

• We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• Required:

• 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.

• A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.

• Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.

• Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.

• Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.

• Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.

• Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.

• Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.

• Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.

• A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.

• Highly desired:

• Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.

• Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.

• Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.

• A plus

• Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.

• Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.

• Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-sr-ux-designer-security

AI Assisted Data Analytics with Power BI (Tutor)

Location :Remote / Online

Salary : Hourly basis

Working days : Monday to Friday

 About the Role

We are looking for an industry mentor to deliver a 24-hour, mentor-led programme in AI Assisted Data Analytics with Power BI. The mentor will guide learners from analytics fundamentals through data preparation, modeling, DAX, interactive dashboards, AI-assisted analysis, and report publishing. The role calls for clear instruction, practical demonstrations, and patient support for learners who may be new to Power BI and AI tools.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building business reports in Power BI and can use AI responsibly to support analytical questions, transformations, DAX development, visual selection, and insight communication. The mentor should be comfortable teaching through business datasets, guided exercises, assessments, and scenario-based problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver interactive sessions and guided practical exercises across all six programme modules within the proposed

• Explain analytics concepts, the analytics lifecycle, business intelligence, data quality, responsible AI, and effective prompt engineering in accessible terms.

• Demonstrate connections to Excel, CSV, and SQL sources; guide learners through Power Query profiling, cleaning, transformations, and merge and append operations.

• Help learners design relationships and star schemas and develop calculated columns, DAX measures, KPIs, and introductory time intelligence calculations.

• Coach learners in building clear interactive dashboards using charts, matrices, slicers, filters, drill-down, drill-through, bookmarks, and tooltips.

• Demonstrate relevant Power BI AI capabilities, including Key Influencers, Decomposition Tree, Smart Narrative, Q&A, forecasting basics, and Copilot where available.

• Guide learners through publishing to Power BI Service, workspaces and apps, sharing, scheduled refresh, basic row-level security, governance, and performance practices.

• Conduct pre- and post-assessments, quizzes, doubt-clearing discussions, and practical reviews; monitor progress and provide actionable feedback.

• Prepare or adapt sample datasets, lab instructions, exercises, and evaluation materials; document learner outcomes and contribute to the consolidated trainer performance report.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Technical Skills

• Strong practical knowledge of Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modeling, DAX, and dashboard design.

• Experience connecting and preparing Excel, CSV, and SQL data, including handling missing or duplicate records and assessing data quality.

• Working knowledge of Power BI Service, publishing, workspaces, scheduled refresh, sharing, and basic row-level security.

• Ability to explain and validate AI-assisted analysis and use Power BI AI features appropriately, with awareness of responsible AI and data privacy.

• Ability to translate business questions into meaningful measures, visualizations, and executive-ready insights.

Experience

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in data analytics or business intelligence using Power BI, including practical report and dashboard development. Experience mentoring or training learners is an advantage.

Soft Skills

• Clear technical communication and the ability to teach beginners through examples and live demonstrations.

• Patient, learner-friendly approach to resolving questions and troubleshooting exercises.

• Strong facilitation, assessment, feedback, and progress reporting skills.

• Ability to manage session time and collaborate with programme stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.

• Experience delivering instructor-led or industry training in analytics or Power BI.

• Exposure to Power BI Copilot and enterprise reporting environments, subject to feature availability.

Key Attributes We Are Looking For

• Passion for mentoring and helping learners build practical confidence.

• Sound analytical judgment and attention to data accuracy.

• An approachable style and willingness to adapt explanations to different skill levels.

• A practical focus on business outcomes, clear reporting, and responsible use of AI.

4f7092d44ceb372d.description: Growth Product Manager Location: Mumbai, India The role in one line Own the revenue we make from artists and small promoters who buy from us without ever speaking to a salesperson. Context The Company' PRO sells advertising and reach to promoters, venues, festivals and ticketing companies through a sales team. Alongside that, a long tail of artists and small promoters buys campaigns directly, self-serve, worldwide. That business already generates several million dollars a year and nobody owns it. It sits between operations, product and marketing. We're making it a line with a number and one person accountable for it. Support for these customers already runs from our India office, so the customers are already ours to serve; what's missing is someone running the funnel. This is not a feature-shipping product role. You carry a revenue and retention number. What you'll own The full self-serve funnel end to end: acquisition, signup, activation, first spend, repeat spend. The funnel surfaces: pricing pages, onboarding, activation messaging, the first-spend flow. You ship these directly with dedicated engineering capacity. Paid acquisition to reach artists who don't know we exist, with your own budget. The cohort picture: what share of artists who spend once spend again within 90 days, and why the rest don't. What you're measured on Self-serve revenue. Repeat-spend rate. Cost per acquired spender, against lifetime value. Volume of accounts crossing the $1,000/year threshold, at which point they surface to an account executive. Who we're looking for A marketer who can ship, more than a product manager who can market. Required: You have personally carried a revenue target on a self-serve funnel. Product-led SaaS, consumer subscription, e-commerce the sector matters less than the fact that nobody was there to blame the sales team. You read cohorts instinctively. Given a signup number, your first question is about the second purchase. You have run paid acquisition with your own budget and know what it cost you to acquire a paying customer. You are comfortable shipping pricing and packaging changes, not only onboarding flows. You can work with engineers directly and specify what you need without a layer in between. Not required: Music industry experience. This is a low-ticket global funnel; the mechanics transfer from e-commerce or SaaS faster than an industry background transfers into analytics. .
